main_body: A snow-capped wooden rack or stall: a snow roof over a dark frame holding tan plank panels, with a dark base strip at the bottom.
top_band: Snow cap in white and pale lavender-blue, rows ~1-6, running down to a blue-grey front edge with icicles at rows ~7-9
evidence: Down the middle column, white snow (rows 1-5) is followed by a blue-grey shaded lower edge with icicles (rows 6-9). Below that is a dark grey frame with tan plank panels set between dark slat lines (rows 10-24), then a dark base. The snow cap is about 5 rows and reads as a horizontal surface above a separate front face, with a darker eave under it, so the structure is 3/4. The object is a prop, not an organic thing, so the supplied kind does not fit.

style.evidence: The snow has about 4 steps with some icicle detail, which is decent. The tan plank blocks are large flat fills of about 5x4 px or more, with no grain or per-plank highlights. The dark frame and base are fairly flat greys and browns. Outlines are mixed: neutral dark grey-purple on the frame and brown at the posts. Tile density sits below the Beodeul stall, which has richer wood grain and several steps per material, so this reads flatter and thinner next to the reference.
